detail.name: Name
detail.deleteBody: The video, its comments and views are deleted, and the link stops working.
detail.trimInverted: The end has to be after the start.
detail.cutFailed: The trimmed copy could not be made. Try again.
detail.trimNoteWebm: When you save, a trimmed copy is made without re-encoding and that is what everyone else gets: the player, the shared page, the embed and the captions. The cut snaps to the keyframe before the start, so up to about 2 seconds before the start stay in their file (the player does not show them). The thumbnail and the GIF are made again from the start of the trim.
detail.trimNoteOther: This file type cannot be cut in the browser: viewers see the trimmed video, but the file they stream still has the trimmed parts. The thumbnail and the GIF are made again from the start of the trim.
detail.retentionLabel: {start}% of viewers saw the start and {end}% the end
detail.regenerating: Making the thumbnail and the GIF from the trim…
